d:
L’oxygène, l'azote, l'hydrogène et tant d'autres petites molécules essentielles sont les piliers invisibles de notre monde et de notre quotidien. Elles sont au cœur des activités du Groupe depuis sa création en 1902.

Un leader des gaz, technologies et services destinés à l'industrie et à la santé, Air Liquide est un maillon essentiel de nombreux secteurs économiques. Avec environ 65 000 collaborateurs, le Groupe sert 4,3 millions de clients et de patients dans 59 pays. Avec un chiffre d'affaires de près de 27 milliards d'euros en 2025, Air Liquide allie performances solides et croissance utile.

Le Groupe est un leader doté d'un modèle économique diversifié et résilient, et d'un fort ancrage local à travers le monde. Grâce à l’expertise en ingénierie de pointe et à son innovation technologique, Air Liquide fournit des solutions déployables à grande échelle et qui améliorent l'efficacité industrielle, accélèrent la décarbonation et renforcent les chaînes de valeur. Positionné stratégiquement sur des marchés en croissance et porté par les mégatendances, le Groupe accompagne les grandes transformations industrielles et sociétales afin de créer de la valeur ajoutée à long terme et construire un avenir durable.

Air Liquide est coté sur la Bourse Euronext Paris (compartiment A) et appartient aux indices CAC 40, CAC 40 ESG, EURO STOXX 50, FTSE4Good et l’indice Dow Jones Best-in-Class Europe.

name: Lyxel&Flamingo (L&F)
d:
Most agencies choose between creativity and data. Lyxel&Flamingo was built so brands never have to.

We are India's full-stack creative and marketing partner to 350+ brands – where the instinct of a storyteller and the rigour of a data scientist sit at the same table on every brief. We call it the dual brain.

The right brain is where brand outcomes are built through creative means. Brand strategy and identity. Mainline and digital communication. Brand films, corporate films, content production across formats. Employer brand and culture narratives. Every brief begins with what the brand needs to achieve in the market and works backward to the work that gets it there. Human judgement, category data, and AI capability all inform what gets made and why.

The left brain makes the right brain accountable. Performance marketing. D2C commerce on Shopify Plus and custom-build environments. Marketplace strategy across Amazon, Myntra, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, and e-pharmacy platforms. Technical SEO, hyperlocal search, and GEO – the practice of building brands to be cited inside AI-generated answers, not just ranked on search.

Underneath all of it: four proprietary AI tools – Crux, Weavr, 1GMB, and Imagiv – built in-house because the tools we needed didn't exist.

650+ team. 5 offices across 3 countries. $250M+ media managed. Highest-tier partnerships with Google, Meta, Amazon, Flipkart, and Shopify Plus.

One agency. No handoffs. No excuses.

Businesses no longer need to plan and procure servers and other IT resources weeks or months in advance. Using AWS, businesses can take advantage of Amazon's expertise and economies of scale to access resources when their business needs them, delivering results faster and at a lower cost.

Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. name: Officially Ethos
d:
Ethos Limited (XNSE: ETHOSLTD) is India’s largest luxury watch retailer and the first in the country to go public. Since 2003, we have grown to more than 100 boutiques across 34 cities, home to many of the world’s most prestigious watchmaking names and a portfolio of exclusive brands we nurture. 

At Ethos, craft is at the heart of everything we do. We believe the details are everything—in the collections we curate, the boutiques we design and the experiences we create for every client. Today, more than 1,000 people bring that passion to life across watches and lifestyle: Ethos Watches, our pre-owned platform Second Movement, the e-commerce-led Hour Studio, and our jewellery and luggage divisions. 

What it means to be part of Ethos: 

Mastery — Deepen your expertise through mentorship and challenging work. 
Pride in Work — The time, tools and trust to create work you’re proud to put your name to. 
Belonging — A community that shares a respect for craft, and for one another. 
Ambition — Clear pathways to grow from passion to recognised mastery. 

And we’re just getting started. Over the next decade, we aim to grow 10x. That journey begins with around 300 boutiques in the next five years and, by 2030, our evolution into a broader luxury retail and distribution platform—powered by a customer-first loyalty programme and an in-house AI Lab.

Through our network of global specialists, we draw on deep expertise and systems thinking to simplify the complex and deliver integrated engineering solutions across a range of diverse environments.   

SMEC has its origins in the iconic Snowy Mountains Hydroelectric Scheme, recognised as one of the civil engineering wonders of the modern world.

d:

Within the group, there are boutique advisory, consulting, and law firms that provide high-quality services in Company Law, Insolvency Law, Securities Laws & FEMA, Corporate Restructuring, Corporate Taxation, Domestic and Global Business Setup, Compliance Management, Documentation, and Regulatory Approvals.

The Group offers Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Corporate Funding, Valuation, and Business Modeling services through Corporate Professionals Capital Pvt. Ltd., a SEBI Registered (Category-I) Merchant Banker, and Corporate Professionals Valuation Services Pvt. Ltd., India’s 6th IBBI registered Valuer Entity.

With a focus on providing holistic, efficient, and cost-effective solutions, the Group integrates its knowledge and expertise with Information Technology. The Group has extensive experience in handling complex transactions and has successfully completed over 15,000 assignments for more than 1,200 Corporate Houses, including PSUs, MNCs, Foreign Subsidiaries, Startups and 650 listed companies. The team maintains a high level of integrity, professional ethics, and confidentiality in all client interactions and assignments.

CP has a Research wing which carries out research on contemporary and emerging issues and actively engages in knowledge sharing by hosting free webinars on every Friday and by providing updates on legal and regulatory matters along with detailed analysis and implications through its real time Newswires and monthly bulletin CP Connect. CP has also emerged as a leader in bringing out up-to-date books on Company Law, IBC and Valuation. Its publication Companies Act, 2013 and Rules and Forms has been the best seller on the subject.

d:
DSCI is a premier industry body on cybersecurity and data protection in India, set-up by NASSCOM®, committed to making cyberspace safe, secure, and trusted through its various initiatives and programs. 

DSCI is engaged with the Indian IT-BPM industry, its clients worldwide, BFSI, Telecom, e-commerce, energy and other domestic sectors, industry associations, data protection authorities, think tanks, and government agencies in different countries. It engages with governments on public policy, conducts industry-wide surveys and publishes reports, organizes cybersecurity & data protection awareness conferences, workshops, projects, interactions, and other necessary initiatives for outreach and public advocacy. DSCI is focused on capacity building of Law Enforcement Agencies for combating cybercrimes in the country and towards this it operates several cyber labs across India to train police officers, prosecutors, and judicial officers in cyber forensics.

Public Advocacy, Thought Leadership, Awareness, and Outreach and Capacity Building are the key roles that DSCI continues to pursue to enhance trust in India as a secure global sourcing hub and promote cybersecurity and data protection in the country.

More details on www.dsci.in

d:

With its portfolio of products, solutions and services, Siemens Energy covers almost the entire energy value chain – from power generation and transmission to storage. The portfolio includes conventional and renewable energy technology, such as gas and steam turbines, hybrid power plants operated with hydrogen, and power generators and transformers. A majority stake in the wind power subsidiary Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy (SGRE) makes Siemens Energy a global market leader for renewable energies. An estimated one-sixth of the electricity generated worldwide is based on technologies from Siemens Energy. Siemens Energy employs 106,000 people worldwide in more than 90 countries and generated revenue of around €39.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Siemens Energy and Siemens Gamesa are currently preparing to transition to Omterra, a new independent brand, with implementation occurring in phases

Siemens Energy is a trademark licensed by Siemens AG

name: Delifrance India
d:
Delifrance- Live Everyday Delicious

About Delifrance:
Délifrance has over 37 years of experience, but the roots of the company started
at the beginning of the 20th century, with our affiliated company,
The Great Mills of Paris.

The Great Mills of Paris began in 1919 as a family founded
business specializing in flour production. Now over 100 years
later, the company is the leading French miller and a major
player within the European frozen bakery industry.

In 1929, The Great Mills of Paris opened the Ecole de Boulangerie (EBP) et de Pâtisserie de Paris. This school is a place for future bakers and pâtissiers to learn industry relevant skills in a renowned setting.

In 1984, the first Délifrance stores opened in Amsterdam, Holland and Antwerp, Belgium and the company rapidly expanded, bringing a taste of France to countries across the world. 

Délifrance and the Ecole de Boulangerie de Paris are proud to
be part of the Grands Moulins de Paris (The Great Mills of Paris),
Vivescia Group. Thanks to this affiliation, Délifrance is able to benefit from the leading French grain cooperative group, ensuring that the grain in Délifrance’s products is of the very best quality. Vivescia works hard to promote sustainable farming, which means Délifrance benefits from an environment driven approach to sourcing our ingredients.

name: Iksha Labs
d:
Iksha Labs builds safe, full-stack agentic systems for healthcare. Our work spans the technology required to take an agent from a promising model to a dependable healthcare system—including voice, reasoning, evaluation, deployment and monitoring. We apply this stack across patient engagement, care coordination and clinical decision support, with safety, data privacy and regulatory requirements considered throughout development.
Our proprietary healthcare policy and guardrail technology adapts each agent to the environment in which it operates. Clinical protocols, consent requirements, data policies, permitted actions and escalation rules can be defined for each organisation and use case. Agents can therefore understand what they are expected to do, recognise when a situation falls outside their authority and involve a human at the appropriate point—enabling safe deployment, reliable execution and predictable outcomes.
Krisper is our flagship voice-agent platform for patient management. It handles appointment booking, follow-ups, reminders and coordination through natural voice conversations, while integrating with the systems and operating policies of each healthcare provider. Its multilingual capabilities help organisations serve patients across languages without adding equivalent operational complexity.
Krisper has already supported over 100,000 patients across hospitals, clinics and independent care providers. By making patient interactions more accessible, responsive and consistent, it helps healthcare teams reduce administrative load, serve more patients and coordinate care more effectively—improving access, efficiency and continuity of care.

name: BIBA Fashion Ltd
d:
BIBA is the most loved ethnic fashion brand in India.

Biba Apparels Private Limited (“Biba”), the Indian fashion giant, stands true to its name.  The brand has been dressing and embellishing demure maidens from every corner of India since 1986.  Contemporary ethnic fashion at affordable price is Biba’s commitment to fashion enthusiasts. 
The word “biba” is a Punjabi endearment for a young and pretty girl.  It implies sublime qualities, compelling Mrs. Meena Bindra, the founder of Biba, to use the name for the line of salwar, kameez, and dupattas that she launched in 1986.  What began as a fashionable and affordable line remains the brand’s ethos today: fashion at affordable price.  In time, new range collections were introduced.  Today, the mix-and-match range has a very contemporary sensibility, and the salwar-kameez range is very ethnic, defined by an Indian crafted look, hand-block prints, and vegetable dyes.  Indian handlooms with traditional embroideries and other techniques are applied in producing the garments.  Unstitched suits and a festive collection for two-to-12-year-old girls cater to the full demands of a woman.  

Biba pioneered Bollywood merchandising in India by providing costumes for Na Tum Jano Na Hum in 2004.  It covered ten more projects, including blockbusters such as Devdas, Hulchul, and Baghban.

With BIBA, always expect a truly unique, wow-inspiring ethnic experience!

name: Asahi India Glass Limited (AIS)
d:
AIS is India’s leading integrated glass solutions company and a dominant player in the car glass segment commanding over 75% of the Indian market. Established in 1987, AIS has grown from being a ‘single product, single customer’ company to a world-class integrated company with 13 plants/sub-assembly units and global customers, offering a comprehensive range of products and solutions ranging from Clear & Tinted, to Reflective, Processed, Frosted and Lacquered Glass to Glass Consultation, Installation and Service.

AIS has three Strategic Business Units (SBUs):

• Automotive Glass
• Architectural Glass
• Consumer Glass

AIS is driven to market-leading innovations providing the right blend between daylight and energy saving, visual comfort and thermal comfort, technology and sensitivity, enabling an age of Green Buildings and the dawn of a truly sustainable future. Standing tall, AIS is a world-class integrated glass company listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange with around 60,000 shareholders. AIS is jointly promoted by the Labroo family, Asahi Glass Co. Ltd. (AGC) and Maruti Suzuki India Ltd. (MSIL).

Also for automotive glasses AIS has started Windshield Experts, India’s first and only specialist in automotive glass repair and replacement. Windshield Experts provide fast, world – class guaranteed service at an affordable price to customers and follows international safety standards for car glass repair and replacement.

Today, AIS - India’s leading glass manufacturer, is driven to market-leading innovations providing the right blend between daylight and energy saving, visual and thermal comfort, technology and sensitivity, along with state of the art glass manufacturing plants. AIS enables an age of Green Buildings and supporting a truly sustainable future.
s: Opal and Decor range of glass

Launched in 2005 as India’s first online travel portal, MakeMyTrip revolutionized travel planning with user-friendly platforms and value-driven pricing. This innovation led to our NASDAQ listing in 2010, making us the first Indian travel company to achieve this milestone.

Our commitment to excellence extends to our people, earning us recognition as one of India’s ‘Top 10 Best Companies to Work For’ for four consecutive years (2010-2013). In 2016, we were named the Best E-commerce Company by the Great Place to Work Institute.

name: Contego - Global Talent Solutions
d:
We are Contego. Apex Talent Hunters. Brand Custodians.
  
We offer something new in the global talent solutions marketplace to companies recruiting and candidates skilled in Legal, HR, Sales & Marketing, Finance, Data, Technology/Digital and Procurement

We don't follow the rules of others. We create our own. 
We stand with our clients/customers as partners.
We seek the best people- apex people and we match their personalities, skills, experience with fantastic brands. Simple.

By standing strong and firm in our beliefs that we are recruiting people, for people, we are breathing new people-centric energy into an industry ripe for change

We have multiple revenue streams from classic headhunting, predictive hiring, interim solutions and competitor insight. All of those underpinned by our commitment to share risk, thinking commercially in terms of fees, added value and transparency in our processes. We have no interest and believe one cannot work with every client. It breeds conflict and agencies have got away with playing all sides for too long. If we partner with you that’s it. We do not do duplicity.
 
We are not a database sweat house full of easily replaceable, homogenised consultants. We are information brokers and experts in a field. Our partners need to know that we do not chase the cheque, nor do we just plug in and send candidates’ CVs we do not know. We are always out there, tracking the talent of the future.
 
We are innovating how our FTSE and beyond clients even interview and try to encourage processes that cut through corporate facades. If we get it wrong we believe we are accountable. After all when 'hiring the wrong person can cost a business 10 times that person’s annual salary!'​ the talent market is a much savvier and commercially aware beast than ever before. 

We, as agencies need to recognise this and adapt our methods accordingly. Contego is leading the pack in this arena.

- We don't use public email accounts (e.g., Hotmail, Yahoo, Gmail). 

Report suspected fraud: thirdpartyincident@wolterskluwer.com. If you've made a payment, contact local authorities.

As a leader in sustainability, the company delivers superior activated carbon products and services to global clients across industries. Applications include water treatment, air filtration, and food & beverage processing, such as sugar refining, oil purification, beverage clarification, and alcohol production. Karbontürk’s solutions efficiently remove contaminants and odors, helping clients achieve operational excellence while promoting environmental sustainability.
Carbomax, based in Frankfurt, Germany, serves as Karbontürk’s strategic sales and distribution hub. Employing international teams across industries, it brings sustainable activated carbon solutions closer to international clients through a strong local presence and customer-focused approach.

⚠️ Alert: Beware of Fraudulent Job Postings and Offers:

We at Kyndryl have been made aware of an ongoing scam in which malicious actors impersonate Kyndryl or its representatives. These fraudulent schemes often appear as requests for employment opportunities. Scammers typically reach out via Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook, email or other communication/messaging platforms.
Common Scam Tactics:
•	Fake Job Offers: Fraudsters send messages offering employment opportunities,  with often times requesting payment for recruitment processing. Kyndryl never charges candidates for job applications or interviews.
•	Non-Payment for Work: Victims may be asked to complete work for a “promised” fraudulent payment that never materializes.
•	Fake Email Correspondence: Messages may appear from unofficial email addresses, such as Kyndryl@gmail.com or recruiting@kyndryl-hr-help.com, and will falsely offer interviews or job placements.
How to Protect Yourself:
•	Kyndryl and its employees will never ask for payment for job applications, interviews, or project work.

d:
ReNew is a leading decarbonisation solutions provider and the first Indian clean energy company to list on Nasdaq (Nasdaq: RNW). With ~28 GW of commissioned and pipeline utility-scale projects including manufacturing, we are a global company with strong Indian roots.

Founded in 2011, ReNew is at the forefront of fighting climate change by offering decarbonisation solutions through utility-scale wind and solar offerings, green hydrogen, carbon markets, and energy storage. ReNew has been a pioneer in leveraging digital technologies to accelerate the transition to green energy and address the unique requirements of the B2B segment in India, where we are the market leader. Our mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner.

ReNew is the world’s first clean energy company to be recognised as a Lighthouse by the World Economic Forum. In 2023, we were recognised among ‘Top 15 Climate Tech Companies to Watch’ by the MIT Technology Review. We are a recipient of the Sustainable Market Initiative’s Terra Carta Seal. The COP28 UAE Presidency presented ReNew the ‘Energy Transition Changemaker’ award for developing and deploying the country’s first round-the-clock power project.

ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects currently contribute to 1.9% of India’s power capacity and are spread across 150+ sites and 18 Indian states. We have helped prevent 0.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1.1% of India’s total power sector emissions, in addition to generating around 130,000 jobs over the past decade.

ReNew generated 22+ billion kWh of clean energy during FY25, enough to power over 6 million Indian households annually, and helped avoid 18.6+ million tonnes of carbon emissions.

d:
We’re OakNorth. And we’re here to shake up commercial lending. Founded by entrepreneurs, Rishi Khosla and Joel Perlman, OakNorth’s mission is to empower the ‘Missing Middle’ – scale-up businesses that are the most significant contributors of economic and employment growth, yet still struggle to access the fast, flexible debt finance they need to grow. We believe that commercial lending should be barrier-free. That’s not just a tagline. It’s a belief at our very core, inspired by our entrepreneurial spirit, driven by unmet financial needs of millions, and delivered by our data-driven tools.
 
OakNorth's India operations have been at the core of group’s global operations since its founding in 2015. With over 500  colleagues spread across our offices in Bengaluru, Gurugram and Hyderabad, we are helping redefine commercial lending. On our team are some of the brightest credit minds in India, along with world-class engineers, tech professionals and data scientists who integrate into a global team helping drive not just faster lending by OakNorth Bank in the UK, but also transforming lending globally through the next generation ON Credit Intelligence Suite. Together, we are helping make lending smarter.
 
But we go beyond lending. Over the past eight years in India, we've built an incredibly strong culture that empowers and champions ambition – an environment where everyone can thrive, speak up, share ideas, and challenge the norm. Characterised by collaboration and driven by inclusiveness, we don't let time-zones, cultures or hierarchies get in the way of success. Our mantra is 'one team', no matter where we are or what we do. 

And we don’t just stop there. We have an unrelenting focus on making communities better and the environment greener. OakNorthers pledge 1% of their time to make a positive difference in the communities we operate in, and we’ve set ourselves a net zero target of 2035. It’s what gives us the passion to excel together. Say hello to OakNorth.

Across industries, cybercriminals are posing as company recruiters using fake job postings and employment offers to trick people into providing personal information or payment. Be alert and never provide personal/financial information or payment to anyone claiming to offer a job opportunity. During the recruiting process, RSM US will never: 
 
	• Ask you for payment to process documents, purchase equipment, or for any other reason.
	• Request your banking or credit card information
	• Send you a check to purchase your own equipment 
 
If you believe you are a victim of a job scam, it’s recommended that you report it to law enforcement, contact your financial institution and notify the website in which the job was listed.

Recro is an AI-native business transformation partner helping mid-market enterprises and scaled digital natives turn complex business goals into predictable, measurable outcomes. Founded in 2014, the company combines deep domain expertise with AI-native talent to help organizations move beyond fragmented digital initiatives toward fully integrated, AI-driven platforms. With a team of 450+ engineers, Recro supports businesses across retail, financial services, and technology, partnering with companies such as Flipkart, Swiggy, BigBasket, Zepto, PayU, Groww, and Upstox.

At its core, Recro exists to safeguard the promises businesses make to their customers while creating socio-economic mobility for technology talent. This philosophy shapes both its client engagements and its commitment to building meaningful, growth-oriented careers for engineers. The company’s vision is to become the most essential transformation partner for enterprises by combining industry context with AI-native capabilities to accelerate growth and create long-term impact.

Recro’s mission is to engineer transformation for mid-market enterprises through a strong ecosystem of domain and technology partners. By leveraging this ecosystem, the company builds AI-native platforms that enable consistency, scalability, and predictable business success.
Unlike traditional IT outsourcing firms, Recro follows an outcome-first model. Instead of selling engineering bandwidth, it deploys specialized FDE Pods made up of “Thinking Engineers” who take end-to-end ownership of business outcomes. These teams combine domain expertise with AI-driven execution to design and build systems that deliver measurable impact.

Recro positions itself as the architect of predictable success, helping enterprises encode operational knowledge into intelligent systems that improve efficiency, strengthen decision-making and unlock sustainable growth.

name: Fintech Cloud Pvt. Ltd.
d:
Fintech Cloud Pvt. Ltd. is a forward-thinking financial operations and technology company that partners with Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) to drive digital transformation and profitability. Our mission is to empower NBFCs by launching tech-enabled, automated lending verticals that require minimal operational overhead and deliver high return on capital.

We specialize in co-creating and managing:

STPL – Short-Term Personal Loans

STBL – Short-Term Business Loans

Loan Lifecycle Automation

Co-Lending Enablement

What We Offer

Our plug-and-play platforms enable NBFCs to launch new lending products quickly and efficiently. We provide the full-stack infrastructure—technology, operations, analytics, and compliance—so our partners can focus on capital deployment and strategic growth.

Our approach is partnership-centric. We work alongside NBFCs as long-term growth allies, offering:

AI-driven underwriting

Seamless borrower onboarding

End-to-end loan servicing

Automated collections

Regulatory alignment with RBI norms

Our Core Platforms

STPL Platform: Tailored for small-ticket personal loans with instant eKYC, credit scoring, and automated disbursals—ideal for salaried and gig-economy customers.

STBL Stack: Focused on MSMEs and self-employed borrowers, using GST data and bank analytics for fast underwriting and flexible repayment.

Loan Lifecycle Automation: Our LOS–LMS–CMS suite powers digital onboarding, disbursements, collections, and borrower engagement through fully white-labeled interfaces.

Co-Lending Integrations: We connect NBFCs to fintechs, aggregators, and embedded finance partners—handling digital agreements, cash flow splits, and MIS dashboards.

Technology and Compliance

Our platforms are cloud-native, API-first, and encrypted with 256-bit security. AI/ML models support fraud detection, credit decisioning, and risk analytics. All systems are compliant with RBI digital lending frameworks, including KYC, AML, and data protection standards.

name: Verma Jewellers
d:
Verma Jewellers offers a wide range of high-quality jewelry, including rings, necklaces, bracelets, and earrings, crafted from precious metals like gold, silver, and platinum. Their collection features exquisite designs, incorporating precious gemstones such as diamonds, rubies, emeralds, and sapphires. In addition to their jewelry offerings, Verma Jewellers also provides services such as custom design consultations, jewelry repairs, and appraisals to ensure customer satisfaction and lasting value.

Verma Jewellers legacy spans generations, originating from pre-partition Sialkot, Punjab, where the family's passion for jewelry began. In 1985, Mr. Vipin Verma and his late father, Mr. Ram Lubhaya Verma, laid the foundation for their dream with a modest silver jewelry showroom in Shalimar Bagh, New Delhi. Despite challenges, Mr. Vipin Verma, then just 14 years old, embraced leadership, steering the company towards growth while honoring their heritage. The pivotal decision of Mr. Vipin Verma to diversify into gold and diamond jewelry in 1992 marked a transformative moment, propelling Verma Jewellers into prominence in North Delhi. By 2014, their relocation to a prominent location on the Main Road in Shalimar Bagh solidified their position in the industry. Led by Managing Director Mr. Vipin Verma, supported by Directors Mr. Karan Verma and Mr. Samanyu Verma, and a dedicated team, Verma Jewellers continues to epitomize excellence and innovation, ensuring their customers receive nothing but the best in craftsmanship and service.

d:

BIOFUELS & FEEDSTOCK
Supported by a dedicated rail fleet and terminal network, our Biofuels business is one of the largest suppliers of biodiesel fuel and feedstock in North America and Europe. 

BIOGAS
Our renewable natural gas (RNG) supply and trading solutions are a trusted source for biogas industry participants throughout the United States and Canada. 

ENVIRONMENTAL COMMODITIES
Targray’s Environmental Commodities business engages in the trading and supply of carbon credits, carbon offsets and renewable energy certificates for compliance and voluntary carbon markets around the world.

SUSTAINABLE COTTON
Our sustainable cotton business connects raw cotton suppliers, traders and end users around the globe through integrated sourcing, logistics, sales and distribution activities.

BATTERY MATERIALS
Targray is a leading supplier to the battery manufacturing and R&D sector. The company's extensive battery materials portfolio is a trusted source for customers in over 50 countries.

ABOUT
Targray is a diversified multinational Canadian corporation founded in 1987 in Montreal, Canada, and headquartered in the nearby city of Kirkland since 2008. The company’s footprint spans the globe with offices in Switzerland, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, Germany, the United Arab Emirates, India, and China.
